Building
Student service
University library
A space for work, reading and study.
The Cerclades university library, place des Cerclades, next to Cergy-Préfecture station. Group work rooms and reading seats.
University restaurant
A friendly lunch break between two classes.
The Crous university restaurant, 5 avenue du Parc. Meals at student prices at lunchtime, on weekdays.
Teaching building
Classrooms and teaching spaces of the campus.
The Chênes site, 33 boulevard du Port: lecture halls, tutorial rooms and computer rooms.
Student house
Information, support and student associations.
The Maison des étudiants, boulevard du Port, just south of the Chênes site. Welcome desk, student associations and information about campus life.
Saint-Martin site
Another teaching site, near place Adolphe Chauvin.
The Saint-Martin site, 2 avenue François Mitterrand, in Pontoise.
Bernard Hirsch site
The site on avenue Bernard Hirsch, with the INSPE.
The Bernard Hirsch site, avenue Bernard Hirsch, south of the François Mitterrand park.
Crous residence
Student housing and Crous welcome desk.
The Crous residence Les Châteaux Saint-Sylvère, boulevard de l\'Hautil. Housing and information about student life.
